verdict.rationale: Windmill's own docs give self-hosting paths: Docker Compose for small setups and a Helm chart on Kubernetes for production. Its llms.txt describes it as open-source and self-hostable, and community users report deploying it themselves on Caprover and on Alpine with Podman plus Docker Compose. missing for 10: evidence on whether the self-hosted edition matches the cloud feature set, and detailed operational docs beyond the deployment-method summary.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product

citations.quote: For small setups, use Docker and Docker Compose on a single instance. For larger and production use-cases, use our Helm chart to deploy on Kubernetes.
Windmill is an open-source and self-hostable workflow engine and developer platform
Pretty easy to selfhost as I deployed it on a Alpine Linux server using Podman + Docker Compose binary.
Yesterday I submitted a one-click install to Caprover, never been so easy to self host.
